BulkDeleteRequest.title: BulkDeleteRequest
BulkDeleteRequest.description:
POST /api/v3/game/bulk-delete — destroy a batch of Games.

By default this surface only removes the database rows (and
their Releases / Dumps via cascade); ROM files on disk stay
put per the per-library lifecycle policy.

When ``deleteFiles`` is true the cascade is extended to the
on-disk ROMs — each Dump's ``path`` is unlinked best-effort
before the row is dropped. The operator opts into this from
the destructive-action modal.

Capped at 500 ids per call so an accidental "select all"
can't run away. The UI shards larger selections client-side
and gates the confirm button with a 1-second delay per
the spec's destructive-action discipline.

pattern that slice 147 ships for text fields.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: Returned ONCE at create-time. Carries the plaintext key.

DatSourceSummary.title: DatSourceSummary
DatSourceSummary.description:
Read-only summary of ingested entries grouped by DAT
authority (no-intro / redump / …). The Settings page renders
this alongside the per-source rows so operators see both:
'I asked for these 4 URLs' AND 'they produced 27 000 entries
last refresh'.

DownloadClientCreate.title: DownloadClientCreate
DownloadClientCreate.description:
POST body for ``/api/v3/downloadclient``.

Plaintext ``password`` / ``api_key`` are accepted here and
encrypted by the application before persistence (FR-022).

DownloadClientRead.title: DownloadClientRead
DownloadClientRead.description:
Public read shape — encrypted blobs are NEVER serialised.

``is_configured`` is True iff the row carries the credential
expected for its type (password for qBit, api_key for SAB). The
field is computed at projection time, not stored.

DownloadClientSchema.title: DownloadClientSchema
DownloadClientSchema.description:
One entry in ``GET /api/v3/downloadclient/schema``.

Lists the implementation, whether it's available (the three
v1-deferred stubs report ``available=False``), and the config
field shape so the UI can render the right add-client form.

DownloadClientUpdate.title: DownloadClientUpdate
DownloadClientUpdate.description:
PUT body — every field optional; ``extra='forbid'``.

If ``password`` / ``api_key`` is included, the row is re-encrypted;
if absent, the existing ciphertext is preserved (FR-022).

Cross-field credential validation is intentionally NOT run here:
a partial update (e.g., renaming the client) shouldn't require
re-sending the password. The route handler runs the full
validation against the merged final state before persisting.

DumpStatus.title: DumpStatus
DumpStatus.description:
Authoritative dump-quality classification.

Order is preference-relevant: ``verified`` is best, ``baddump`` /
``overdump`` are worst.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Types de ressources à inclure dans le bundle. Au moins un requis — sinon exporter tout la DB n'a pas de sens.

include_secrets.title: Include Secrets
include_secrets.description: Si True, les blobs chiffrés (Fernet) sont inclus. L'install cible DOIT partager le même ROMARR_AUTH_SECRET_KEY pour les déchiffrer, sinon les secrets seront perdus au flush.

ExporterRead.title: ExporterRead
ExporterRead.description: One exporter row in the catalog.

FieldEditRequest.title: FieldEditRequest
FieldEditRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v3/game/{id}/field — manual operator edit.

The slice-147 edit-in-place half of the anti-RomM-#1770
surface. Only text fields (title, summary, developer,
publisher, age_rating) are editable here — numeric / list
fields will join via their own dedicated payloads.

``value`` may be ``null`` to clear the field. ``auto_lock``
defaults to True because operator edits are sticky by
definition: an edit the aggregator silently overwrote next
refresh is exactly the bug the constitution forbids.

FieldLockRequest.title: FieldLockRequest
FieldLockRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v3/game/{id}/locked-fields — toggle one field.

The slice-146 anti-RomM-#1770 surface. ``field`` is
constrained to :class:`ProviderField` so the only fields
the operator can lock are the ones the aggregator could
overwrite — locking an unrecognised field would be a no-op
that silently drifts.

GameLookupRow.title: GameLookupRow
GameLookupRow.description:
One row in the lookup response — a deduped game.

Slice 410 — when the same game shows up in multiple
providers (IGDB + ScreenScraper + MobyGames…), they merge
into a single row whose ``providers`` list carries every
provider that returned it. The canonical ``providerName`` /
``providerGameId`` point at the highest-confidence hit so
the one-click Add path stays unambiguous.

GameMetadataProviderRead.title: GameMetadataProviderRead
GameMetadataProviderRead.description: One per-provider snapshot for a Game's metadata audit page.

GameMetadataRead.title: GameMetadataRead
GameMetadataRead.description: Aggregate metadata payload for the game's Metadata tab.

GameToggleRequest.title: GameToggleRequest
GameToggleRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v3/game/{id} — operator-toggle subset.

Only fields that are NOT owned by the metadata aggregator
are mutable here. Today: ``monitored`` (always required) +
``library_id`` (optional — present when the operator picks
a different library / profile cascade for the game).
Adding more operator-toggleable bits is straightforward —
they go in this schema.

GrabRequest.title: GrabRequest
GrabRequest.description:
POST /api/v3/rom/release/grab.

Operator picks an exact result from a manual search. ``force``
overrides the blocklist gate (FR-022 / SC-006); the pipeline's
profile gates still apply.

GrabarrWizardRequest.title: GrabarrWizardRequest
GrabarrWizardRequest.description: POST body for the atomic Add-Grabarr flow.

ImportMode.title: ImportMode
ImportMode.description: Comportement à l'import quand un item avec le même `name` existe.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Sous-ensemble des ressources du bundle à importer. None = tout ce qui est présent dans le bundle.

IndexerSchemaEntry.title: IndexerSchemaEntry
IndexerSchemaEntry.description:
One entry in ``GET /api/v3/indexer/schema``.

Prowlarr expects a list of indexer "implementations" Romarr supports
so it can build its UI for adding a new indexer. We support
Newznab and Torznab.

IntegrationGameRequest.title: IntegrationGameRequest
IntegrationGameRequest.description:
POST body for ``/api/v3/game/integrations/request``.

IGDB-native: the caller passes the IGDB game id + the IGDB
*platform* id; Romarr maps the platform to its own catalogue via
``Platform.igdb_id`` and binds the game to the first library.

IntegrationGameResult.title: IntegrationGameResult
IntegrationGameResult.description: Response envelope for the integration request endpoint.

IntegrationPlatform.title: IntegrationPlatform
IntegrationPlatform.description: One IGDB platform Romarr can acquire games for.

IntegrationPlatformsResult.title: IntegrationPlatformsResult
IntegrationPlatformsResult.description: Response for the integration platforms listing.

IntegrationStatusResult.title: IntegrationStatusResult
IntegrationStatusResult.description: Response for the integration status check.

JobRead.title: JobRead

JobRunRead.title: JobRunRead
JobRunRead.description:
Read-only history shape; the lifecycle helper writes
these rows.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description:
Terminal + transient states a job_run can be in.

``RUNNING`` is the initial value the lifecycle helper writes;
every run MUST transition to one of the four terminal states
when the runner returns or shutdown forces it.

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description:
All fields optional + ``extra='forbid'`` so typos fail
fast. Only mutable columns are exposed (no audit, no
``is_factory_default``).

LibraryRead.title: LibraryRead
LibraryRead.description:
Read shape — never exposes ``exporter_romm_api_key_encrypted``;
instead carries ``is_romm_configured`` derived from the blob.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry
LogEntry.description: One structured log entry — Sonarr-shape camelCase JSON.

LookupAddRequest.title: LookupAddRequest
LookupAddRequest.description:
POST body for ``/api/v3/game/lookup/add``.

The ``providerName`` + ``providerGameId`` pair identifies the
chosen candidate from the GET response; everything else is
operator input from the Add modal.

Manifest.title: Manifest
Manifest.description:
Retourné par `GET /api/v3/backup/manifest` — l'UI en dérive les
checkboxes disponibles + les compteurs.

ManifestEntry.title: ManifestEntry
ManifestEntry.description: Une ligne du manifest — dit à l'UI ce qui est backupable + combien.

ManualImportEntry.title: ManualImportEntry
ManualImportEntry.description:
One row in :class:`ManualImportRequest`. Identifies a file
on disk plus the operator's chosen target Game / Release.

ManualImportListingRead.title: ManualImportListingRead
ManualImportListingRead.description: Wire shape for one candidate row.

ManualImportRequestPayload.title: ManualImportRequestPayload
ManualImportRequestPayload.description: One row in the bulk-import POST body.

ManualImportResultRead.title: ManualImportResultRead
ManualImportResultRead.description: Per-entry outcome on the bulk-import response.

ManualMatchRequest.title: ManualMatchRequest
ManualMatchRequest.description:
Match an existing ``unidentified_dump`` row to a Game (and
optionally a Release) — POST
``/api/v3/rom/unidentified/{id}/match``.

NamingConvention.title: NamingConvention
NamingConvention.description: Filename naming convention recognised by the parsers.

NamingPreviewResponse.title: NamingPreviewResponse
NamingPreviewResponse.description: Response body for the naming-template ``/preview`` endpoint.

NotesUpdateRequest.title: NotesUpdateRequest
NotesUpdateRequest.description:
PUT /api/v3/game/{id}/notes — operator-owned free text.

The notes column is operator-owned and never touched by the
metadata aggregator, so the surface is intentionally
minimal: write the new value, get the updated Game back.
Set ``notes=null`` (or empty string) to clear.

NotificationCreate.title: NotificationCreate
NotificationCreate.description:
Payload for ``POST /api/v3/notification``.

The plaintext Apprise URL arrives as :class:`SecretStr`; the
handler encrypts it and extracts the scheme prefix before
handing the row to the model layer.

NotificationRead.title: NotificationRead
NotificationRead.description:
Read shape — never exposes ``apprise_url_encrypted``;
surfaces a redacted ``apprise_url_redacted: '<scheme>://...'``
so the operator can identify the target without leaking the
URL's host / token.

NotificationUpdate.title: NotificationUpdate
NotificationUpdate.description: All fields optional; ``extra='forbid'`` so typos surface.

PackPlatformDiff.title: PackPlatformDiff
PackPlatformDiff.description:
Per-platform projection of an ingest plan.

The ingest pipeline returns one of these per slug touched by a
pack apply. ``reason`` is populated when ``action == 'skipped'``
(e.g., ``"user-overridden"``).

PackUploadResult.title: PackUploadResult
PackUploadResult.description: Returned by the upload + apply / re-apply endpoints.

PlatformStats.title: PlatformStats
PlatformStats.description:
Per-platform breakdown row (slice 105).

Drives the Dashboard's "disk per platform" panel. ``total_size_bytes``
sums :attr:`Dump.size_bytes` across every Dump bound to the
platform's Releases — null when the platform has no Dumps.

ProviderCandidate.title: ProviderCandidate
ProviderCandidate.description: One row in the per-provider relink picker.

ProviderCandidatesResponse.title: ProviderCandidatesResponse
ProviderCandidatesResponse.description:
The candidate list + the variants tried so the operator can
see which query actually hit (useful when the auto-strip is
over-eager).

ProviderField.title: ProviderField
ProviderField.description:
Canonical field-name vocabulary used by every provider.

The aggregator's per-field priority logic is keyed on these names.
Adding a field is a configuration change (insert ``field_priority``
rows), NEVER a schema migration — see ``data-model.md``.

ProviderHit.title: ProviderHit
ProviderHit.description:
Slice 410 — one (provider, provider_game_id) pair carried
by a deduped lookup row. The same game returned by multiple
providers collapses into one ``GameLookupRow`` whose
``providers`` list enumerates every provider that found it.

QualityDefinitionFormat.title: QualityDefinitionFormat
QualityDefinitionFormat.description: One ``PlatformFormat`` row in the aggregated summary.

QualityDefinitionPlatform.title: QualityDefinitionPlatform
QualityDefinitionPlatform.description: One platform with its formats nested.

QueueEntryRead.title: QueueEntryRead
QueueEntryRead.description: One queue entry — Sonarr-shape camelCase JSON.

RefreshMetadataResponse.title: RefreshMetadataResponse
RefreshMetadataResponse.description:
JSON projection of :class:`AggregationResult`.

``fields`` flattens each ``(value, winning_provider)`` tuple to
a small object so the UI can render the per-field provenance
badges (FR-008 visibility).

Rejection.title: Rejection
Rejection.description: Pipeline rejection record — one per disqualified candidate.

RejectionCode.title: RejectionCode
RejectionCode.description:
Why a candidate was rejected by the 13-step pipeline.

Stable strings so the UI can localise + the history view
can group/filter without fragile string-matching.

ReleaseSearchRequest.title: ReleaseSearchRequest

ReleaseToggleRequest.title: ReleaseToggleRequest
ReleaseToggleRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v3/rom/release/{id} — operator-toggle subset.

``extra=forbid`` keeps this surface narrow: free-form
Release edits (region, naming, dump_status, etc.) belong
to the import pipeline / DAT identification flows, not
to a hand-rolled PATCH.

providerGameId.title: Providergameid
providerGameId.description: The provider's id for the chosen game (string for generality; integer-id providers parse it server-side).

ResourceKey.title: ResourceKey
ResourceKey.description:
Types de ressources exportables. Ajouter un membre → enregistrer
un handler dans `registry` pour l'activer.

RetryResponse.title: RetryResponse
RetryResponse.description:
Response to POST ``/api/v3/rom/import/retry/{import_id}``.
Wraps the ``ImportHistoryRead`` produced by the retry.

RomPackConfigRead.title: RomPackConfigRead
RomPackConfigRead.description: Global ROM-pack defaults (the singleton config row).

RomPackCreate.title: RomPackCreate
RomPackCreate.description:
Slice 460 only exposes ``url``-sourced packs; ``grab``
packs are created by the watcher in slice 463.

RomPackGrabRequest.title: RomPackGrabRequest
RomPackGrabRequest.description:
Grab one indexer result as a ROM content pack.

Mirrors the manual-search :class:`GrabRequest` shape — the
operator picked an exact result from a manual search — plus
the pack metadata (``name`` / ``platform_id`` / size cap).
The result is dispatched to a download client; the watcher
routes the completed download to the pack ingest pipeline
(slice 463) instead of the single-file importer.

RomPackItemAssociate.title: RomPackItemAssociate
RomPackItemAssociate.description:
Manual association payload — the operator picked the Game
this unmatched ROM belongs to.

ScoreBreakdown.title: ScoreBreakdown

ScoreContribution.title: ScoreContribution
ScoreContribution.description:
One additive contribution to a candidate's total score.

``source`` keeps the contributing subsystem identifiable so the
UI can group by source ("region: USA First +4, custom_format:
Verified Dump +100, size_bonus: -10").

SearchRoundReport.title: SearchRoundReport
SearchRoundReport.description:
The top-level result of one search-mode round.

Carries every parsed candidate (rejected included) so the UI
history view can show the full picture, plus the subset that
won and were dispatched. ``overcap_indexers`` lists indexers
whose responses exceeded FR-029's hard cap and were truncated.

``profile_expected_conventions`` snapshots every
``naming_convention`` value the active library's custom-format
set explicitly rewards (the ``no-intro-convention`` /
``redump-convention`` / … CFs). The UI uses it to color the
convention chip:
  - candidate's convention IS in the list → green
  - the list is non-empty and candidate's convention is NOT in
    it (or unknown) → red (the profile cares but this release
    doesn't satisfy any of the expected authorities)
  - the list is empty → grey (profile is indifferent to the
    naming convention)

SourceOrderRead.title: SourceOrderRead
SourceOrderRead.description: The global source ranking used by the platform materializer.

SourceOrderReplace.title: SourceOrderReplace
SourceOrderReplace.description:
Full source_order replacement. IDs not listed rank after
listed ones, ordered by id.

SyncItemOutcome.title: SyncItemOutcome
SyncItemOutcome.description: One YAML body processed during a sync run.

SystemStats.title: SystemStats
SystemStats.description:
Aggregate counts surfaced on the Dashboard (slice 104).

Cheap to compute (one COUNT per metric) so the Dashboard
can poll it as often as it likes. The ``imports24h`` /
``importsSuccess24h`` pair lets the UI render a one-line
"n imported today (m successful)" stat without a separate
history scan. ``by_platform`` (slice 105) adds the
per-platform breakdown for the disk-usage panel.

TagDetail.title: TagDetail
TagDetail.description:
Sonarr `/tag/detail/{id}` shape — lists the IDs of every
entity currently using the tag, grouped by entity type. The
JSON keys are camelCase (``gameIds`` / ``indexerIds`` / ...)
via Pydantic aliases.

TagRead.title: TagRead
TagRead.description:
Sonarr-shape tag read.

`usage_count` (slice 135) is denormalised — total count of
entity assignments (games + indexers + notifications +
releases) currently pointing at this tag. 0 means the tag
is unused; the Tags page surfaces this so operators can
spot stale tags at a glance.

TriggerKind.title: TriggerKind
TriggerKind.description: How the run was started — audit attribution column.

TriggerRequest.title: TriggerRequest
TriggerRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/v3/job/{id}/trigger``.

``kwargs`` carries operator-supplied parameters for
parameterised jobs (e.g. ``{"gameId": 42}`` for the
``RefreshGame`` runner).

TriggerResponse.title: TriggerResponse
TriggerResponse.description:
Response body — points the operator at the freshly-
written ``job_run`` row so they can poll for progress.

UnidentifiedDumpRead.title: UnidentifiedDumpRead
UnidentifiedDumpRead.description:
Extended read shape covering the spec 008 columns
(``rejection_reason``, ``library_id``, ``suggested_game_id``)
plus the foundation columns. Returned by GET
``/api/v3/rom/unidentified``.

UpdateMeRequest.title: UpdateMeRequest
UpdateMeRequest.description:
Self-service password / email / preferences update.

All fields optional — clients send only what they want to change.
Username changes are NOT supported here; admins do that via the
user-CRUD endpoints (next slice).

UserPublic.title: UserPublic
UserPublic.description: Public-facing User shape — never carries hashed_password.

ValidateResult.title: ValidateResult
ValidateResult.description:
Returned by the ``/validate`` endpoint — same shape as
:class:`PackUploadResult` but the database state is guaranteed
untouched and ``action`` carries the would-be outcome.

WantedReleaseRead.title: WantedReleaseRead
WantedReleaseRead.description:
Sonarr-shape camelCase JSON for a wanted release.

Mirrors only the fields the Wanted page UI reads — the full
Release detail is on the Game tabbed view, not here. Keeps
payload small for typical 50-row pages.

`platformId` (slice 134) is denormalised from the owning Game
so the row can render a platform pill without a follow-up
fetch.

WebhookAcceptedResponse.title: WebhookAcceptedResponse
WebhookAcceptedResponse.description: 202 ACCEPTED body — the import has been queued.

WebhookPayload.title: WebhookPayload
WebhookPayload.description:
Common shape every supported download client posts.

qBittorrent, SABnzbd et Deluge ont chacun leur mécanisme natif
d'exécution de script au download-complete :
- qBit : Settings → Downloads → « Run external program »
- SABnzbd : Settings → Categories → « Script »
- Deluge : plugin Execute (Preferences → Plugins → Execute) qui
  appelle un script bash sur ``Torrent Complete``. Le script hit
  cet endpoint avec l'info-hash en tant que
  ``download_client_native_id``.

On accepte les 3 kinds. Les prochains (Transmission, NZBGet)
landent dans une slice ultérieure.

_IndexerSecretsRead.title: _IndexerSecretsRead
_IndexerSecretsRead.description:
Just the decrypted secret bag — kept off IndexerRead so the
list endpoint never accidentally leaks the key.

_TestProbePayload.title: _TestProbePayload
_TestProbePayload.description:
Body for ``POST /api/v3/indexer/test`` — probes a transient
set of values without persisting an Indexer row first.

Used by the Create / Edit modals so the operator validates
the URL + key combo before saving.

romarr__api__routers__community__Preview.title: PreviewItem
romarr__api__routers__community__Preview.description:
One item entry from a source's manifest — displayed in the
preview modal before the operator commits to an apply.

romarr__downloaders__types__Connectivity.title: ConnectivityTestResult
romarr__downloaders__types__Connectivity.description:
Outcome of one ``test_connectivity(impl)`` round-trip.

The shape is intentionally flat (``ok`` + ``error_code``) so the
UI doesn't need a try/except path — every failure mode round-trips
through the same JSON envelope (FR-008, SC-006).

romarr__indexers__connectivity__Connecti.title: ConnectivityTestResult
romarr__indexers__connectivity__Connecti.description: Outcome of a single connectivity probe.

romarr__platform_packs__api__sources__Pr.title: PreviewItem
romarr__platform_packs__api__sources__Pr.description: One YAML's dry-run outcome from a preview call.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Override the auto-detected kind ('raw' | 'github_dir'). Leave null to let the server guess from the URL shape.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Per-user API key issued via POST /api/v3/auth/api-key. Sent as the X-Api-Key header. Compatible with Notifiarr / Recyclarr / Homepage.

ApiKeyQuery.name: apikey
ApiKeyQuery.description: Same key as ApiKeyHeader, transported in the URL query string for tools that can't add headers.

CookieSession.name: session
CookieSession.description: Browser cookie session established via POST /api/v3/auth/login. Used by the Romarr UI.

BearerJwt.description: OIDC-issued JWT in the standard ``Authorization: Bearer <token>`` header. Used for SSO callers.
